description: Returns up to 3 real Korean given names for a person (their name in Latin letters, e.g. 'Emma', 'Sofía') — names people in Korea actually have that sound like it or share its meaning — plus how the name itself is written in Hangul (Emma → 엠마). Each name comes with Hangul, romanization, an easy 'sounds like' spelling, hanja and their meanings, why it matches, the first everyday Korean words built from the name, and a page link.

era.description: modern = popular since 2000s, classic = 1980s–90s. Default any.

gender.description: Gender feel of the Korean name. Default: the name's own.

language.description: Language of the meanings and links: en, es or pt. Default en.

name.description: The person's first name in Latin letters, e.g. 'Emma'.

name: find_korean_name
title: Find a Korean name
